next.reason: 1985 GR10: 'The NO REWIND and REVERSED phrases will be ignored if they do not apply to the storage medium'. 2023 keeps the NO REWIND half: §2023:14.9.27.4 GR11 'The NO REWIND phrase will be ignored if it does not apply to the storage medium' (OPEN successful, status '07', as §2023:9.1.13.2 GR6 and 1985 status 07 both say). REVERSED (obsolete in 1985 4.3.1) is absent from the 2023 OPEN format §2023:14.9.27.2 and every 2023 OPEN rule, so the REVERSED case of this rule has no 2023 counterpart: a case removed.
